newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Speedway Motor Sports sells $125 mln debt.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Speedway Motor Sports sells $125 mln debt.

text.p: The following 144a private placement of debt from Speedway Motor Sports Inc was priced on Wednesday via NationsBanc Capital Markets Inc, according to market sources.
The company owns and operates motor speedways in the U.S. including the Atlanta Motor Speedway, Bristol Motor Speedway, Charlotte Motor Speedway and Texas Motor Speedway.
